subject: Post-call recap: PayFlux decision sprint calendar, ops owners & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@payflux.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: PayFlux decision sprint calendar, ops owners & next steps

Hi Alex / Sana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed operational sprint calendar so we can lock scope and dates. Please confirm or flag changes by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize owners and the kickoff invite.

Key success criteria (what PayFlux will use to decide success):
- Ingest sample transaction corpus and return embeddings + semantic search within SLA (90th pct < 450ms)
- End-to-end query accuracy: top-3 relevance > 78% on your test set
- Cost baseline: token cost + infra delta within the target you shared (budget mark in attachment)
- No sensitive data leakage; deployment adheres to your retention rules (see security checklist)

Proposed evaluation plan and timeline (decision sprint):
- Week 0 (prep, before kickoff): sign mutual NDA/SOW, grant staging access, share sample data specs
- Week 1 (kickoff + baseline): kickoff, initial ingest, smoke tests, week1 readout (POC_Week1_Agenda.pdf attached)
- Weeks 2–4 (iterative validation): tuning prompts, embedding schema checks, throughput tests, weekly readouts
- Week 5 (final readout): consolidated metrics, replayable evals, recommended config for pilot/prod

Owners (Redwood / PayFlux):
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole (me) — commercial runway, cadences, readouts
- Redwood Infra Eng: Ben Carter — staging infra, model variant, KV cache config
- Redwood Customer Success: Stephanie Nguyen — onboarding runbook, training ops
- PayFlux Technical Lead: Alex Johnson — data access, acceptance test ownership
- PayFlux Product: Sana Patel — success criteria signoff

Immediate next steps (please action):
1) Alex: confirm the staging S3 access window and an internal point of contact for creds by Wed 10/7
2) Sana: confirm the acceptance metric for top-3 relevance or send the preferred evaluation script
3) PayFlux procurement: review and sign the SOW link (DocuSign) so we can schedule kickoff (we can start the week of 10/12)
4) Redwood (Ben / Stephanie): we will provision a 2-GPU staging cluster and share credentials once SOW is executed

Attachments: PayFlux_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, POC_Week1_Agenda.pdf, Redwood_POC_Onboarding_Checklist.docx

Thanks — I’ll send a formal calendar invite once we have confirmation on the kickoff date.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@payflux.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@payflux.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PayFlux decision sprint calendar, ops owners & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Quick notes from our side: we’re aligned on the success criteria but need to clarify two items before committing to the 10/12 kickoff.

1) Procurement / PO timing: our procurement team needs an explicit cost worksheet and approximate spend by week to pre-approve; can Redwood provide a delta estimate for the staging cluster + per-token baseline?
2) SOC2 / security evidence: we’ll need the SOC2 report and a short data flow diagram for the staging arrangement (we cannot put PII into staging without signed controls).

We can tentatively hold 10/12 10:00–11:00 PT for kickoff, but will confirm by 10/07 after procurement review.

Also looping in Sana for acceptance criteria: Sana — we prefer precision@3 on the canonical queries; our current threshold target is 0.60 but we might accept 0.65 depending on false-positive behavior.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Technical Lead, PayFlux
alex.johnson@payflux.com | +1 415-222-3344

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@payflux.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PayFlux decision sprint calendar, ops owners & next steps

Appreciate the clear plan — a few operational notes from infra: 
- I’ll spin up a 2xA10G staging pool with the recommended model variant (gpt-medium-openopt) and enable KV cache. Expect creds within 24–48 hours after SOW signed.
- Cost estimate (approx, staging only): $1,200/week for reserved staging cluster + anticipated inference cost of ~$0.03/token (we’ll refine once we see the real token distribution). I’ll upload a short worksheet to the Drive link you shared.
- For SOC2 / security artifacts: security@redwood will share the SOC2 redacted report and a brief data flow diagram to your security mailbox. If PayFlux needs an on-call security sync we can arrange it Thurs 10/8.

Operational ask for PayFlux: please provide a sanitized sample of 5,000 transactions (redacted PII) and the evaluation script you want to use — that will let us produce reproducible metrics for week1.

I’ll take ownership of staging infra and the week1 throughput test. Stephanie, can you prep the onboarding runbook and the kickoff agenda slides?

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@payflux.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PayFlux decision sprint calendar, ops owners & next steps

Thanks Alex / Ben — this is great. Confirming next actions and the kickoff slot:

Confirmed kickoff (tentative): Mon 12 Oct 2026, 10:00–11:00 PT — I’ll send calendar once we get the signed SOW. If procurement needs a formal estimate I’ve attached the cost worksheet and labeled the weekly staging delta.

Finalized immediate next steps: 
- PayFlux (Alex): share sanitized sample dataset + acceptance script by EOD Thu 10/8 (this enables week1 baselining)
- PayFlux (procurement): complete DocuSign by Mon 10/11 if possible
- Redwood (Ben): provide staging cluster creds and cost worksheet link within 48 hours of DocuSign completion
- Redwood (Stephanie): send kickoff invite & agenda slides; prepare onboarding runbook and weekly readout template

Meeting agenda preview (Kickoff, 10/12):
1) Introductions & scope alignment (10m)
2) Data & creds handoff check (10m)
3) Week1 baseline plan and success metrics (20m)
4) Ops cadence & escalation path (10m)
5) Next steps and close (10m)

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876543 | Prep Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC

If PayFlux confirms the sample data timeline and procurement cadence we’ll lock the kickoff. Otherwise we’ll push to the following week.

Best — see you soon,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
